name: App shell
tagline: Topbar, workspace links and error screens
summary: The frame around every signed-in page: a topbar with the account menu, five workspace links with counts, search and a create menu, plus warnings, loading states and error screens.

flow.label: Protected route
flow.note: Resolves the viewer, starts the change feed and renders the layout for every signed-in page.

flow.label: DashboardLayout
flow.note: Loads counts for the nav, registers shell shortcuts and lazy-loads the dialogs.

flow.label: Topbar
flow.note: Account menu, workspace links with badges, search trigger and create menu; a slimmer bar on phones.

flow.label: Shell overlay store
flow.note: One value says whether the palette or the repo picker is open, so only one shows at a time.

flow.label: Repository picker
flow.note: Lists pinned, recent and all repositories; the pick opens, pins or starts a create action.

flow.label: localStorage
flow.note: Pinned (max 12) and recent (max 6) repositories are kept per user in the browser.

features.name: Topbar and workspace nav
features.summary: Overview, Inbox, Pull requests, Reviews and Issues with live counts and an unread dot. On phones the same items become a bottom tab bar.

entry.role: The five destinations, their keys and badges

features.name: Create menu
features.summary: New issue, pull request or release. Inside a repository it goes straight there; anywhere else it first asks which repository.

entry.role: The pencil button and its menu
Decides: navigate now or pick a repository
Runs a create action from menu, key or palette

features.name: Repository picker
features.summary: A searchable dialog (O then R) to switch repository, pin one, or choose the target of a create action. Pinned and recent come first.

entry.role: Pinned and recent repositories from localStorage
What happens after a repository is picked

features.name: Account menu
features.summary: Avatar menu with Profile, Repositories, Settings, shortcut help, report an issue, a light/dark/system switch and sign out.

entry.role: The avatar dropdown at the left of the topbar

features.name: Bottom bar warnings
features.summary: Dismissible notices for blocked organisations, GitHub timeouts and missing permissions, plus a prompt to install the browser extension.

entry.role: Renders the warnings under the page
In-memory warning list any feature can add to
Extension offer, hidden once it is detected

features.name: Route loading states
features.summary: On a hard load a page's own empty state is server-rendered in place of a spinner. Pending UI stays hidden for its first 300 ms so it never flashes.

entry.role: Default pending component for every route

features.name: Error and 404 screens
features.summary: One screen turns an error into rate limit, re-authorize, no access, not found, offline or timeout, each with a matching action.

entry.role: Default error screen inside the shell

entryPoints.role: The shell: topbar, outlet, bottom bar, dialogs and nav counts
Parent route of every signed-in page

The workspace destinations and their badges

goodParts: Overlay state is one explicit union (none, command-palette, repo-picker) in lib/shell/shell-overlay.ts, so two overlays cannot be open at once.
Pin, recent and create-action rules are pure functions with tests (lib/shell/workspace-repos.test.ts, create-actions.test.ts).
